name: grid-fragment-absolute-static-area
derivation: The hypothetical sole Grid item's static rectangle is its area. With gap3 and columns1fr/2fr, width123 makes column2 x43,width80; centering a14px absolute child gives x76. At width93 its area is x33,width60 so centered x56. With all insets auto these are area-relative static positions, not offsets added to the area a second time. Height89 consumes61+28 on pages at0/83. The second page is a positioning shell. Grid13 exact layout is not defined; section13.1 is nonnormative. The per-page allocation policy is hand-derived here.
